This lesson covers Sign Reading 3.4.1 Poems: Structure, part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: which they: - identify a topic of interest - carry out research about the topic 1. Why do we read or recite poems?
